description: Weak layer-0 unit. Strongest when the opponent's last move was in column 1 or column 5 and the player to move has most of their stones in columns 0 and 4 (column 0 counts most), with few stones of either side in column 5. Move order does not matter. Other last-move columns give at most weak activation. Much near-threshold firing is not explained by this.
effect: None measurable: forcing it to max changes no column probability (0.00 on 3 positions).
notes: Activations are tiny (threshold 0.001, max 0.005). act probes: last col 1/5 gates it; mover's share of stones in col0 (+), col4 (+), col5 (strongly -); opponent col5/4/0 slightly -. Dev scores: p1 rule F1 0.237, additive token model (submitted) F1 0.240 AUROC 0.61, gated probe-fitted model F1 0.11-0.20. Top band (99.9%) is ~90% last col 1/5 but bands 5-7 only ~45%. Simulation nan, steer no effect. Possibly a random direction.
